response.justification: Bogdan brings a long, varied engineering career (roughly 15+ years counting early freelance and web work) with genuine breadth across web, mobile, embedded, low-latency backend systems, and open-source founding of GISCollective. However, the role targets a director-level individual contributor driving cloud and AI platform strategy, and the resume shows almost no depth in AI/ML beyond recent MCP tooling and agent infrastructure work, no evidence of large-scale cloud platform architecture or advisory work with strategic customers/partners, and no track record of influencing product direction at an organizational level. The seniority trajectory (Senior/Staff Software Engineer) is also a level or two below the expected principal/director scope.
strengths: Broad 15+ year engineering range: embedded, low-latency backends, web, mobile, DevOps
Founder of an open-source geo-data platform with real users, plus strong community teaching and conference talks
Recent hands-on exposure to agentic AI tooling (MCP code generators, agent frameworks)
concerns: No demonstrated AI/ML expertise or AI products/platforms at the scale the role requires
Limited cloud platform strategy experience; AWS CDK usage is the main cloud signal
Career level is Senior/Staff IC, not principal/director-scope strategic leadership
